analysis:
The 2009 Congress manifesto said about 40% of elected panchayat representatives were women, against a reservation of 33%.

A PIB release citing the State of Panchayats Report 2008-09 put women at 35.80% of district panchayat members in 2010. A 2024 PIB release put women at over 46% of all elected representatives in Panchayati Raj institutions.

The available official figures bracket the manifesto's 'about 40%' figure. The 2010 figure covered district panchayats only, so the claim is treated as broadly supported rather than exact for every tier.
